description: MCCL State PAC is pleased to announce its endorsement of Eric Lucero for State Senate. Our endorsement is based on Eric's steadfast commitment to the pro-life cause. This is evident in his 100% pro-life voting record in the Legislature and leadership in advancing lifesaving legislation.
